preregistration_correction: v1 of this config wrongly used graph_seed=11/sinks=2 (16 motif edges, not the paper's graph). Corrected BEFORE any grid training to the exact main-campaign config: graph_seed=123, sinks_per_relay=4 (3 motifs x 6 edges = 18 edges, 123 total edges, matching the paper). Training hyperparameters also aligned to the main campaign: lr=0.006, batch=128.
question: On the controlled 96-node graph family, is the topology advantage gated by BOTH task-relevant path survival AND background in-degree density (two-factor interaction)?

design.graph: 96 nodes, module sizes [25,17,12,11,11,7,7,6] (MaleCNS annotation prior); motif = two-hop convergence motifs injected by the frozen generator with seed=123, sinks_per_relay=4 (3 motifs accepted, 18 edges, 123 total edges) -- the exact main-campaign graph

density_levels.construction: background-only graph sampled with default_rng(seed=1000+s) at p_in=0.06*s, p_out=0.004*s; motif edges then injected; shortcut edges a,b->sinks removed

survival_levels.construction: delete (18-k) uniformly chosen motif edges with rng seed 77

conditions: A=0 no-graph control once per seed (graph-independent)
design.data: make_dataset(512 train seed 1, 512 test seed 999, d=16, noise 0.06) identical protocol to main campaign
design.training: GNN width 64, 2 rounds, epochs 120, Adam lr 0.006, batch 128, cpu (Apple M1), paired seeds -- matching the main campaign protocol
design.primary_statistic: effect(s,k) = mean_seed [acc_real(s,k) - acc_A0(seed)]; 5000-resample bootstrap CI on seed-level deltas

preregistered_predictions.P1: effect(s=1, k=18) > 0 (replication of the controlled-graph effect)
preregistered_predictions.P2: effect(s, k=18) decreases monotonically in s (density gate: even a fully surviving path is diluted at high in-degree)
preregistered_predictions.P3: effect(s=1, k=9) < effect(s=1, k=18), while at the highest density both k=18 and k=9 sit at chance (two-factor interaction)

outcomes_admissible: P1 and P2 confirmed (two-factor mechanism on controlled family)
negative_results: all cells reported, no run selection
device: Apple M1 CPU, PyTorch 2.13.0 (local; no GPU available)
